thread:
Ana Torres: heads-up i'm opening a docs PR to make pricing tier visibility clearer in the billing docs and to add a tiny TS SDK snippet + one-line curl. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/999 (internal)

Liam Brooks: nice. what's the core clarity change?

Ana Torres: currently the tier table is ambiguous about whether "committed units" are monthly or daily. changing label to `Committed units (monthly)` and adding an explicit example row per tier. also adding a short FAQ: "How do I know which tier I'm in?" with steps to check the dashboard and billing export.

Zoe Park: can you paste the TS snippet you'll include? i'd like to use consistent naming for the SDK samples repo.

Ana Torres: added this small TypeScript example to the PR:

```ts
// typescript example (minimal)
import fetch from 'node-fetch'

await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/report', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ tenant_id: 'acme', metered_units: 1024 })
})
```

Ana Torres: also included a single-line curl quickcopy next to it for customers who copy curl.

Liam Brooks: for dashboards, are we changing any permalinks? support needs stable links to find tenants.

Ana Torres: no UID changes. updated panel captions to include a small "tier hint" and added a PromQL example that joins committed_units for clarity. sample PromQL in the PR:

```
sum by(tenant) (increase(redwood_metered_tokens_total{usage_type="generated"}[30d])) / avg_over_time(tenant_committed_units[30d])
```

Zoe Park: alert guidance? customers keep asking for recommended warning/critical values.

Ana Torres: recommending warning at 75% and critical at 95% of committed. added both avg and max variants in the docs so teams can pick what fits their SLOs. also called out burst accounts: suggest bumping warning to 85% to avoid noisy alerts.

Liam Brooks: please paste the alert example you added so ops can reuse it.

Ana Torres: docs alert snippet (simplified):

```
ALERT ApproachingCommitted
IF max_over_time((sum by(tenant)(increase(redwood_metered_tokens_total[1h])) / tenant_committed_units) * 100[5m]) > 95
FOR 15m
LABELS {severity="critical"}
ANNOTATIONS {summary="Tenant {{ $labels.tenant }} nearing committed capacity"}
```

Zoe Park: small nit: add a one-liner in the FAQ that explains burst usage does not alter tier assignment. otherwise looks good.

Ana Torres: added that line and a tiny migration checklist for internal teams: update SDK samples, update saved dashboard captions, notify support and partners 7 days before rollout.

preview-bot: CI passed  preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/changes/999 (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

support-bot: support notify set to true. will post a short playbook after merge with example customer copy and triage steps.

Liam Brooks: pulled the preview  two micro-nits flagged in PR comments (table alignment + a missing alt text on the tier chart).

Ana Torres: fixed both. scheduled a reminder to remove the transitional wording 14 days after merge. will merge after one more approval.

Zoe Park: approved. will sync samples repo once merged.

Ana Torres: merging in 5m unless objections. thanks all!
